name: 感謝を記録した週
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset: LH13-0009「感謝を記録した週」, ONE compact Japanese weekly gratitude strip.
REFERENCE HIERARCHY: Image1 ORIGINAL Calm screenshot controls glyph geometry, proportions, optical/stroke weight, spacing, circle anatomy and visible state. Use ONLY the top week card. Image2 FigCraft mock is SECONDARY for Japanese copy/layout; its thin chevron and plain solid-green check circle omit original detail. Image3 approved Lighthouse bus is STYLE ONLY for white surfaces, gentle forest-green gradients and soft downward shadows.
Render one white rounded card on pure white canvas, logical390x177 proportion. Header centered「12月14日の週」, one left-pointing navigation chevron at upper left. Restore the original's visibly thick, rounded chevron shape in slate#526173, not the mock's rough hairline vector. No right arrow or plus. Below header,7 equal columns: weekdays「日」「月」「火」「水」「木」「金」「土」; dates「13」「14」「15」「16」「17」「18」「19」below circles in that exact order. Preserve the source's displayed date assignments even if they do not match a real calendar; do not recalculate.
Visible state: six empty white circles with fine neutral outlines. ONLY Friday18 is completed. Its completion control follows ORIGINAL layered circular anatomy: smooth forest-green gradient outer disk/rim #174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E, clean white smaller inner disk, centered forest-green checkmark of original rounded proportions. Keep original check geometry and optical weight, do not substitute a random icon. Gentle edge light, subtle shadow, no plastic gloss. Friday18 has no invented second badge or value.
Accent decision: source's pink/multicolor completed badge expresses actual completion. Adapt that single completion state to Lighthouse forest green; all unrecorded dates remain neutral. No broad mint fill, random colors, extra emoji, metrics, text, subtitle, CTA, legend or navigation.
Typography locked: Meiryo Regular14/24 week label, Regular12/16 weekdays/dates, tracking0; ink#1D1D1D and secondary#6E6E6E. Full compact component visible with modest white margin, aligned baselines/columns, subtle neutral card border and restrained downward shadow. No cropping, device frame or watermark. Raster design candidate only, no working/editable claim.
reviewNotes: 原画とモックを実見、原画を太く丸い左矢印と白中心/外輪/チェックの構造の主参照として復元。単一完了状態のみ原画の多色/ピンクをブランド緑グラデーションに適応。結果実見:12月14日の週、日-土/13-19、金18だけ完了、他6空円、白中心の完了リング、白面と見切れなしを確認。原画の表示上の週/日付不整合はそのまま保持。厳密な書体と操作動作は未証明。reviewedは画像候補のエージェント視覚レビューで所有者承認/編集性/実装ではない。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
